_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0-for-35 coil base rate makes HOLD the statistically honest default — the macro tailwind is real but no breaker has fired, so a directional UP call here is a guess against a proven 0% win rate.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both see UP as the likely next phase via the Aug-2024 analog, but the analyst explicitly downgrades to low conviction and demands confirmation signals while the narrative presents it with higher confidence
next_move.confirmed_if: funding breaks above 60 AND stablecoin_growth turns positive AND btc_momentum_30d holds above 50
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 80 OR btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d drops below 85 OR etf_flows collapse below 70
